name: @universe/portal
description: Portable SvelteKit 3 + Svelte 5 SSG + UnoCSS static portal for universe

scripts.typecheck: bun x --bun svelte-kit sync && bun x --bun svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: bun x --bun biome check src tests e2e package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts uno.config.ts
scripts.fmt: bun x --bun biome check --write src tests e2e package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts uno.config.ts
scripts.fmt-check: bun x --bun biome format src tests e2e package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts uno.config.ts
